title: Island Entrance
text: You've made it to the island! You find Gideon has met an untimely end near the entrance to the treasure. You must open the vault entrance with the secret sequence only you know!
dmNotes:
# Who's in this scene

- Gideon (dead) - Lucien will claim that Gideon fell to his death (lie). If the party investigates his body, they will find he was beaten to death and killed before being thrown into the water.
- Lucien Voss
- The Party

# What you need to do

- Lie to the party and claim Gideon fell to his death. If you're convincing enough the party will simply move on
- If the party successfully investigates, you must reveal that Gideon's death was not caused by falling, but by being beaten to death.

# Scenarios

## Party chooses to fight Lucien

If the party figures out what happened, they can kill Lucien and find the evidence that shows they were framed on his corpse.

## Party works with Lucien

If the party works with Lucien, he will enter the vault and help the party fight the guardian of the vault.
